value.rationale: The full configuration space of equal-bond/equal-angle six-membered ring models has competing chair, boat, and small-angle inward-crown classes. Radius of gyration is a natural spatial-spread statistic, previously unoptimized in the inspected conformation studies. This theorem identifies its sharp unique optimizer uniformly for every bond angle and an exact three-midpoint nonnegative stability deficit. It adds a geometric discriminant rather than a routine sample value; it does not assert energy optimality.
